name: Can I prevent future kitchen trip hazards after they're removed?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future kitchen trip hazards after they're removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can take steps to prevent future trip hazards. Regularly inspect your flooring for wear or damage, ensure all rugs have non-slip backing, keep pathways clear of clutter and cords, and promptly clean up spills. Investing in durable flooring materials and professional installation can also contribute to long-term safety. We can offer specific recommendations during our service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, regularly inspect flooring, use non-slip rugs, keep paths clear, and promptly clean spills to prevent future hazards.
